title: Laredo police ask for help finding runaway Sophia Martinez, 13
excerpt: Sophia Martinez, 13, was last seen on October 11, 2026, and has been missing for more than a month, according to the Laredo Police Department. Police are asking anyone with information to call 955-285-0579.
content:
LAREDO — The Laredo Police Department is asking for the public's help finding Sophia Martinez, a 13-year-old who was last seen on October 11, 2026, and has been missing for more than a month.

Police describe Sophia as 5 feet tall and 110 pounds, with brown eyes, brown hair and a medium complexion. She has a mole on her left cheek.

Anyone who knows where Sophia is can contact the Laredo Police Department at 955-285-0579. Police say all calls and information will remain anonymous.

Source: Laredo Police Department (Facebook, Nov. 13, 2026).
